Tata Steel CEO Warns of Chinese Import Threat, Outlines Expansion Plans

Tata Steel CEO T V Narendran has raised concerns about the threat posed by Chinese steel imports to India's domestic industry. He stated that the company is exploring additional electric arc furnace projects and aims to expand its production capacity to 40 million tonnes by 2035. However, the target for reaching this domestic capacity may be delayed by three to five years. The company is also seeking government support for its green steel transition in the Netherlands and is developing a project to produce hydrogen using steel plant off-gases at its Odisha facility, utilizing Utility Global's H2Gen technology for a 10 TPD facility.
